Parent Alert Note
fields.options:
Parent RFID Absence Alert

When enabled, SLCM checks every hour whether a student has swiped their RFID card within the configured threshold hours. If no swipe is found, an email alert is automatically sent to all parents/guardians on record.

Threshold: Hours without any RFID swipe before the alert fires.
Active Days: Select the days on which alerts are active. Leave empty for every day.
Active Window: Alerts are only sent between the From and To times to avoid off-hour noise.
Email Template: Frappe Email Template used for the alert. Variables: student_name, programme, academic_year, last_swipe_time, check_time, threshold_hours.

RFID General Note
fields.options:
RFID Attendance — Overview

Enable RFID to allow student swipe data from physical card readers (installed at classroom gates and terminals) to flow automatically into SLCM.

Swipe Mode:
  In Only — records the first swipe of the day as entry. Suitable for classrooms where exit is not tracked.
  In and Out — records both entry and exit swipes. Used when gates track both directions.

Once enabled, go to RFID Card Management to assign cards to students, view unassigned swipes, and perform bulk imports.
